name: village-store-coins-grow-only-v1
description: ⭐ THE SECOND OF THE TWO COIN BETS, ALONE: THE MINT PLUS THE GROW SINK AND NOTHING ELSE. rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard 1 and rules.economy.coinSupplyPerPlayer 5 make the coin exist; rules.economy.coinPaysGrow is true, so a coin stands in for a building's activation card (V8), and rules.economy.coinGrowOnFullBuilding is true, so a coin-Grow may target a FULL building (V9). rules.economy.coinPaysBuild is FALSE and rules.economy.coinPaysSuitCost is FALSE with it, because a coin that pays a suit requirement but not a build is not a rule anybody has proposed. This arm converts barn into repeatable ABILITIES and never into tableau. ⛔ IT HAS TWO CONTROLS AND BOTH READINGS ARE WANTED. Against overlays/notice-board-visit-host-draw-by-seats-v1.overlay.json it is the whole effect of the Grow bet on the base game; against overlays/village-store-coins-v1.overlay.json, which differs from it in exactly the two Build leaves, it is the Build bet measured by subtraction. Its sibling is overlays/village-store-coins-build-only-v1.overlay.json. ⛔ C100 IS STILL OPEN AND NO NOTICE BOARD ARM IS RULED IN AS THE SHIPPED GAME: the shipped default is rules.turn.visitCurrency 'commons', so THIS IS AN ARM ON TOP OF AN ARM and every report header quoting it must say so. The seat-shaped host draw is only the best-performing configuration measured (5 PASS / 1 FAIL / 11 OBSERVE), not a ruling. ⛔ V9 IS THE STRONGEST SINGLE CLAUSE IN THE PACKAGE AND IT IS ON IN HERE, WHICH IS DELIBERATE AND IS A DECISION THE BUILDER MADE. Dean ruled V9 in as part of the Grow bet on 12/09/2026 and his reason is that the reward for filling a barn should be awesome, so the honest isolation of 'the Grow bet' is V8 and V9 together. ⚠️ THAT MEANS THIS ARM CANNOT SEPARATE THEM. A V8-without-V9 arm is one leaf away (rules.economy.coinGrowOnFullBuilding false) and it is NOT written, because the seven overlays of section 8 of the handoff do not include it; if the Grow bet reads badly, that eighth arm is the first thing to build. ⭐ WHAT V9 IS: THE FIRST CLOG BYPASS IN THIS GAME SINCE THE MEEPLES. Expect the board mix to move with it, because the Apiary board's bought Grow reaches a full building by the same clause and Apiary sits at 12% of plays. ⛔ AND THE TIER 3 LAYER NEEDS RE-PRICING AGAINST IT (C110): the cost/threshold curve is inverse ON PURPOSE, expensive low-threshold buildings are strong BECAUSE clog is their brake. That is card balance, not a reason to reopen the rule and not a reason to hold up this arm. ⭐ THE PROPERTY TO WATCH FOR, BECAUSE IT IS THE DESIGN'S BEST CLAIM: THE COIN-GROW IS SELF-LIMITING. A building you only ever coin-Grow never fills, so it is never harvested, so it never puts cards in your barn, and barn cards are what make coins. If the arm shows coin-Grows rising while minting falls, that self-limit is real; if both rise together, it is not. ⭐ THE BUILDER DEFAULTS THIS ARM CARRIES, NAMED RATHER THAN DISCOVERED, because on 05/09/2026 an arm built for one purpose carried three unnamed knob changes and ruling it in ruled all four. Dean confirmed the indicated reading on all of D1 to D9 on 12/09/2026 and ruled D7 explicitly. D1: cards paid into the exchange go to the SUIT'S DISCARD and never out of the game. D2: ANY delivery mints, including one bought by a Notice Board power. D3: declining to mint is EXPLICIT, so the turn settles cleanly. D4: an empty supply mid-conversion STOPS rather than refusing the whole exchange. D5: ⭐ A COIN-GROW DOES FIRE 'WHEN ACTIVATED' ABILITIES, which is the whole point of a Grow and is the load-bearing default of THIS arm in particular, stated because V8 places no card and a reader may assume otherwise. D6: a coin does NOT count as a card for any card text that counts cards paid, the same family as the O17 fix. ⚠️ D7, D8 and D9 have no subject here because there is no meeple. ⛔ THE ACCEPTED CONSEQUENCES, RULED IN WITH EYES OPEN: cards that trigger on a PLACEMENT do not fire on a coin-Grow, A16 The Beekeeper's Veil being the obvious one, and A21 The Wax Hall does not count a building held empty this way. ⛔ WHAT MAY NOT BE QUOTED OFF THIS ARM. (1) THE BONUS RATE IS A SHARE OF TURNS AND NEVER PLAYS PER TURN; judging the band on plays cost this project a re-run of five arms on 09/09/2026. (2) NO LEVEL HERE IS COMPARABLE WITH A reference-v14 OR EARLIER NUMBER; only a delta paired on identical seeds against a named control is sound. (3) THE BARN GLUT READS +0.5 IDENTICALLY ACROSS THIS WHOLE FAMILY ON BYTE-IDENTICAL PER-SEAT LINES, so read the per-seat rows and NEVER the pooled median. (4) The hand limit of 7 is the SIMULATOR'S bound (C7) and the table plays with none. (5) ⛔ OWN-CROP BUILD SHARE IS NOT THIS ARM'S NUMBER. It belongs to rules.economy.coinPaysSuitCost, which is off here, so a flat 83% is the absence of that leaf and not a finding about the coin. ⛔ C113, THE ARM'S OWN TEST. docs/village-store-2026-08-19-v1.md section 1 tested this exact rider-on-Deliver placement and ruled it out: 'Free / a rider on Deliver. No cost, so it is always correct. Breaks everything.' Dean's answer of 12/09/2026 is that a valid delivery is a precondition and the capped supply bounds the reward. THE CORE OBJECTION STANDS AS A TEST: if every player converts every spare card every time, the August verdict was right and THE PLACEMENT IS WHAT TO CHANGE. Read the conversion rate beside how often the supply is empty. ⛔ EVERY PASSENGER IS PINNED BY NAME. THIRTY LEAVES. The control's twenty, unchanged and in its own order: rules.turn.visitCurrency, bonusTiming, selfVisitAllowed, hostDrawOnVisit, commonsTake, startingMeeplesPerColour, meepleAsCard, slotToll, meepleCapPerColour; rules.economy.noticeBoardThreshold, noticeBoardBlocks, unclaimedBoardsToCentre, noticeBoardsBySeats.2, .3 and .4, commonsColourMatch, commonsWildPair, endgameCoinCost, farmsteadCoinPower; and rules.turn.hostDrawOnVisitBySeats.4. ⛔ TWO OF THOSE ARE COIN LEAVES AND THEY STAY OFF ON PURPOSE: rules.economy.endgameCoinCost null and rules.economy.farmsteadCoinPower false belong to the separate commons-with-coins arm of 10/09/2026 and are a second mint and a second sink; keeping them off is what makes rules.economy.storeCoinsPerCard the only faucet. Then the six coin leaves, four on and two off as above, and the four meeple leaves pinned at their shipped values so the delivery meeple cannot ride in: rules.turn.deliveryMeepleSpace null (which means defer to the existing meeplesPerTile seeding and NOT 'no meeples'), meepleSpendTiming 'start', meepleSpendPerTurn null (unlimited) and meepleSpendDistinctColours false. ⚠️ HOW TO RUN IT: --overlay= with --watchlist, never --sweep=, and always --n=1580 (4,820 games, five mirrors, reference-v15 seeds), paired on identical seeds. A bare --watchlist is a 1,580-game pilot and must not be quoted beside a real run. ⚠️ AS OF COMMIT e5aea08 ALL TEN NEW LEAVES ARE INERT: they exist in the data layer and no branch of play reads them yet, so this arm currently measures identically to its control. A run before the engine slices land proves the file parses and validates, and nothing else. ⛔ PINNED AT dairyGrowsBuilt 'none' ON 12/09/2026, WHEN THE BASE MOVED TO 'paidWild'. Every number published off this arm was measured BEFORE Dean ruled the Dairy board's follow-on Grow in, so the pin is what keeps this file reproducing what it measured. A new arm that wants the ruled rule should say so by name. ⛔ PASSENGERS PINNED 12/09/2026: Dean's plain-action balloon and Village Store ruling moved sixteen shipped leaves at once. This overlay predates that flip and every report taken against it does too, so each of those leaves is pinned here BY NAME at its PRE-FLIP value. Without it an arm read as a delta against a pre-flip base would silently gain a one-card flight, an always-present Aerodrome and a live coin economy. That is the 05/09/2026 passenger lesson: an overlay that should not move with the shipped default has to pin every knob the flip moved. ⛔ APIARY PINNED 14/09/2026: Dean ruled the Apiary board's retext in as the shipped default (apiaryPower 'deckGrowWild', "Grow a building using the top card of any deck", the deck card paying any activation cost). This overlay predates it, so apiaryPower is pinned here BY NAME at 'sow' (the S12 Sow 2) and it still replays its own game.
